# The paths a pull request may change without a `Review:` line for its head (CLAUDE.md;
# the rule is "Reviews" in minos-moderation/minos, docs/claude/sessions.md): what
# programista-prosty may change (.claude/agents/programista-prosty.md, "You may change"),
# narrowed where its list is a judgement. Every other path is on the risk list, so a new
# folder starts there. Not here: the Polish text inside __() in src/Admin/ and
# src/Notice.php, because those files hold the code around the text (a change of the text
# alone cannot be told from a change of the code by its path), and the test fixtures,
# because the tests prove the receiver and the submission with them. CI reads this list from
# the pull request's base.
#
# One pattern a line: `dir/` matches everything below dir, `**/name` a file of that name in
# any folder, anything else one exact path. A `!` line is a risk path inside an exempt one
# and wins over it. tests/Repo/ReviewTrailTest.php pins the risk markers of
# tests/Repo/ClaudeRulesTest.php against this list.
README.md
docs/development.md
!**/CLAUDE.md
